title: [review] messaging.py:93: sent_messages() returns mutabl
description: Returns `[self._sent[msg_id] for ...]` which are direct references to internal dicts. Callers can mutate internal state. Compare with inbox() at line 97 which correctly returns `[dict(message) for message in self._inbox]`. Should be `[dict(self._sent[msg_id]) for msg_id in self._sent_order]` or use copy.deepcopy for nested structures.
